description: A saddled strider (its AI on) ridden with a warped fungus on a stick held: cold and slow on stone, onto a 2-deep lava pool's surface (warm), boosted by using the stick, turning about on the lava; pushed under the surface (it rises), back west onto the stone; sneaking off.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:warped_fungus_on_a_stick
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
